body:
## Pensieve 0.6.5

### Fixed
- Finding a paper's code no longer picks an "arXiv daily" digest instead of the paper's own repository.

### New
- **Courses.** Learn a field lesson by lesson, from the new *Courses* section. Each lesson explains the key terms from scratch, walks you through 2–3 papers to read closely (how each one works and how it was tested, and what to look at yourself), links talks by the authors, and ends with questions to check yourself and open research questions. Your progress and notes sync across your devices.
- **The first course: Embodied AI — from VLA to World Action Models.** 25 lessons, from "what is a robot policy" to the open questions of 2026: vision-language-action models (π0, π0.5, π0.7…), robot data, simulation, reinforcement learning from zero, world action models and the VLA-vs-WAM debate. With a glossary, 130 talks and a 中文 view.
- **Paper radar.** Every day it finds the new papers worth your time in a course's field — from the labs and people you follow, with code that took off on GitHub, or upvoted on Hugging Face — and tells you why.
- **Course files.** Save a course as a file, or add one, to make your own courses.

### Download

| Your system | File |
|---|---|
| Windows 10 / 11 | **Pensieve-Setup-0.6.5.exe** |
| Mac with Apple Silicon | **Pensieve-0.6.5-mac-arm64.zip** |
| Mac with Intel | **Pensieve-0.6.5-mac-x64.zip** |
| Linux (64-bit) | **Pensieve-0.6.5-linux-x86_64.AppImage** or **Pensieve-0.6.5-linux-amd64.deb** |
| Android 8+ (HarmonyOS via 卓易通) | **Pensieve-0.6.5-android.apk** |
| iPhone / iPad (iOS 15+) | **Pensieve-0.6.5-ios-unsigned.ipa** — install with Sideloadly or AltStore ([how](https://photonghost308.github.io/pensieve-app/#ios-install)) |

Already using Pensieve? It updates itself (Settings → General → Updates). Your notes stay as they are.
